changelog: - **Canvas tools: keyboard focus told apart from the chosen tool.** In the tool row, Select, Pan, Select a region and Group frame: a tool that has keyboard focus but is not chosen now has a dashed ring; the chosen tool keeps its solid ring. Before, both rings were the same, so the chosen tool and the focused one looked alike, above all in the dark theme. High-contrast mode, and a chosen tool with keyboard focus, look as before.
